subject: a short shelf of books with a reading lamp leaning over it
sourceSummary: Survey the existing literature on a topic and synthesize it into a structured review: a planner sets the scope, inclusion criteria, and the themes to organize around, then a researcher gathers and characterizes each source (method, finding, quality), then a copywriter synthesizes them thematically rather than source-by-source, surfacing consensus, disagreement, and gaps.
